text.description_html:
Dorma Grade 1 Commercial Door Lever

This easy-to-grip Dorma Lever is designed for commercial, institutional, and industrial use in facilities such as schools, hospitals, and factories where a long life of dependable operation must be combined with a high degree of resistance to physical abuse. This lever is durable with a 10 year limited warranty and an ANSI Grade 1 rating. It is UL fire rated for a 3 hour fire door. The door thickness rages is 1-5/8" to 2"; and the available backsets include 2-3/8", 2-3/4", 3-3/4", and 5".

Features of the Dorma CL 800 Series Door Lever:

  • ANSI/BHMA A156.2 Series 4000 Grade 1
  • UL and CUL for 3 hour applications for UL10B and UL10C
  • Meets ANSI A117.1 and ADA requirements for barrier-free accessibility
  • CSFM approved, CA State Reference Code 1989
  • Keying 6-pin, C123 keyway.
  • Comes Packaged with two keys per lock.
  • 10 Year limited warranty for all functions.
  • Meets Buy American Act

Specifications of the Dorma CL800 Lever:

  • Rose Diameter: 3-7/16"
  • Projection: 2-9/16"
  • Lever Length: 4-3/4"
  • The door thickness range is 1-5/8" to 2"
  • Available backsets are 2-3/4" (70 mm), 2-3/8" (60 mm), 3-3/4" (95 mm) and 5" (127 mm).
  • Satin Chrome Finish

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: Non-latching and non-locking. Used for one side of door as a pull or to match trim.
  • Passage/Closet(ANSI F75): Latching only, both levers always unlocked.
  • Exit Lock (ANSI F89): Outside lever is always fixed. Inside lever always unlocked and free for immediate egress.
  • Exit/Communicating Passage (ANSI F111):Deadlocking latch bolt operated by inside trim. Blank plate outside. Minimum clearance 1" on single doors and 2" between doors.
  • Privacy (ANSI F76A): Locked by the use of a push-button located on the inside lever. Outside emergency unlocking with screwdriver (not included). Turning inside lever or closing door releases button. Inside lever is alway free for immediate egress.
  • Entry/Office (ANSI F82A): Pushing the button on the inside lever locks outside lever. Use of key outside releases push button unlocking outside trim. Operating inside trim releases push button unlocking outside trim. Inside lever is always unlocked and free for immediate egress.
